headline: Khadim India reports Q2 FY27 financial results
summary: Khadim India Limited has submitted its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing details the company's financial performance over the preceding three and six months. Retail investors tracking the footwear sector can review these numbers to assess the company's revenue and margin trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data shows Khadim India's recent business performance.
